$comment: Every optional production integration, as data. A product registers one by appending a row here — never by adding a branch to scripts/compose-production.mjs. Fields: id (unique); profile + app register a Compose profile that may only be requested when the app is selected; service selects the overlay from the setup closure's service list; requiredEnv selects the overlay when every listed variable is present and non-empty (the usual shape for an external provider that only needs a secret mounted); overlayFile is pushed onto the Compose file chain in this file's declaration order; environment is merged into the Compose environment when the integration is active; edgeRoute names the Caddy fragment the edge composes for it; requiresPublicApiDomain rejects single-domain topologies whose API would stop being publicly reachable; secrets lists the Docker secret names the overlay mounts, cross-checked against docker/secret-entrypoint.sh.
